reviews.comment:
El lugar es, única opción y como que el playero lo sabe, tardo un montón en atendernos y medio que no te da pelota, tuvo que salir la chica del Shop para atendernos, sino estaríamos todavía que el playero siga hablando con su cliente amigo, la del Shop una genia

(Translated by Google)
The place is the only option, and the attendant seems to know it. He took ages to serve us and was practically ignoring us. The girl from the shop had to come out to help us; otherwise, we'd still be waiting while the attendant chatted with his "friend" customer. The shop girl was a gem.
